description: Find companies by name words, optionally only in one country, of one industry or within a head count range: Wikidata companies that match the words (operating ones only, best match first, with website, founding date, head count, LEI and the GLEIF legal entity) and, when no industry or head count filter is sent, GLEIF's active legal entities whose legal name holds the words (found_in gleif). Industry and head count filters read Wikidata alone, and a company with no Wikidata head count is left out by a head count filter. Small firms are often missing. No person is named. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO 3166-1 code (DE, US, VN) or an English country name.

industry.description: Optional industry words, such as bank or software, or a Wikidata item id such as Q880371.

max_employees.description: Optional: only companies with at most this many employees.

min_employees.description: Optional: only companies with at least this many employees (Wikidata head count).

page_size.description: Wikidata companies to return, 1 to 25 (default 10); as many GLEIF entities may follow.

q.description: The company's name or words in it, such as Siemens or Acme Logistics.

name: data_company_search
title: Search companies by name
